tools.name: discover_symbaiex_agent_access
tools.description: Use when the user wants to connect an agent to SYMBaiEX or discover its public evidence tools. Returns only canonical public setup and contract URLs; it never enrolls, authenticates, posts, or reads credentials.

tools.name: subscribe_symbaiex_newsletter
tools.description: Prepare a SYMBaiEX newsletter subscription using the email address the user provides. The user must review and manually submit the visible form.
